title: Trio Petroleum Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: Trio Petroleum Corp, a micro-cap Delaware energy company (ticker TPET, listed on NYSE American), filed a Form 8-K on April 8, 2026 under Item 8.01 'Other Events' to disclose multiple prospectus amendments related to an At Market Issuance (ATM) Sales Agreement with Ladenburg Thalmann & Co. Inc. The filing chronicles the evolution of the offering from January 9, 2026 through April 7, 2026, with the most recent Amendment No. 7 leaving $945,000 in placement shares available from a maximum aggregate offering amount of $20,973,000.
key_points: Trio Petroleum Corp is a Delaware corporation (EIN 87-1968201) headquartered at 23823 Malibu Road, Suite 304, Malibu, CA 90265
Company entered ATM Agreement with Ladenburg Thalmann & Co. Inc. on January 9, 2026 for at-the-market equity offerings
Original aggregate offering amount was $3,600,000 under Registration Statement No. 333-281813 (effective September 10, 2024)
As of April 7, 2026 (Amendment No. 7), total shares previously sold amounted to 20,651,554 shares with aggregate sales price of $20,027,510
Remaining placement shares available as of Amendment No. 7: $945,000 out of maximum offering amount of $20,973,000
Company is classified as an emerging growth company under SEC regulations
